value.rationale: The motivating work presents a physically natural quantum-classical first-passage crossover but leaves direction and quantitative convergence of the entire normalized Laplace transform unspecified. The new global cross-threshold order provides nonperturbative direction; the inverse-level bound and nonzero sharp coefficient provide an explicit error-calibration rule over every bounded measurement argument range. It complements rather than merely rewrites the known finite transform; it is not a table recomputation or arbitrary threshold slice.
